FormEase Pro Feature Suite

Purpose-built by an educator to automate school forms, simplify grading, and eliminate administrative paperwork friction.

📄 Complete Official DepEd School Forms Suite

FormEase populates error-free official forms formatted to exact DepEd specifications:

SF1 — School Register

Automated student profiling, LRN tracking, guardian details, Balik-Aral/ALS flags, IP group, previous school type (Public/Private), CSV/Excel batch import, and Profile Diff Conflict Resolver.

SF2 — Daily Attendance

Smart daily attendance logging, monthly auto-summaries, present/absent/tardy/dropout tallies, percentage of attendance calculations per month.

SF5 — Report on Promotion

Instant final rating calculations, General Average compilation, action taken (Promoted, Retained, Conditional), and Level of Proficiency summary tables.

SF6 — Promotion Summary

Grade-level and school-wide consolidated statistical summary on learner promotion and achievement levels across all advisory sections.

SF8 — Health & Nutrition

Automatic BMI, Height-for-Age (HFA), Weight-for-Age (WFA) calculations and nutritional classifications (Underweight, Normal, Obese, Stunted).

SF9 — Learner Progress Card

Print-ready quarterly report cards for Elementary, JHS, and SHS with Core Values matrix, attendance summary, digital signatures, and custom grading remarks.

SF10 — Permanent Record

Multi-year historical academic tracking, general averages, subject ratings per quarter/final, school last attended resolution, remedial logs, historical encoding modal, and certification block.

LIR — Learner Info Record

Comprehensive student dossiers, parent contact cards, anecdotal logs, health logs, emergency contacts, and individual printable profile sheets.

📊 MATATAG & SHS E-Class Record Engine

DepEd Transmutation Tables

Automated conversion of raw scores into transmuted grades using official DepEd transmutation tables without manual lookup errors.

MATATAG Component Weights

Pre-configured Written Works, Performance Tasks, and Quarterly Assessment weights tailored per learning area.

SHS Grading Framework

Specialized Core, Applied, and Specialized subject grading across Semester 1 and Semester 2 with mid-term/final rating auto-computations.

Consolidated Grading Hub

Master grade reference matrix for advisory teachers displaying all subject area scores in a single grid, general average calculation, and honors ranking exports.

Temporary Grade Slips

Quick-print utility for issuing mid-quarter grade slips with digital signatures to parents.

📈 Reports Tab — Complete 6 Analytics Components

Comprehensive data analytics and early warning reporting suites:

1. Quarterly Summaries & MPS Report

Subject-by-subject Mean Percentage Score (MPS), Pass Rate (%), Grade Distribution bands (90-100 down to Below 75), interactive Radar Charts, and strongest/weakest subject analytics.

2. Subject Performance & Delta Comparison

Term-over-Term (T1 vs T2 vs T3) subject performance tracking with Delta indicators and Priority Intervention List (Urgent <70, Remediation 70-74, Monitor 75+).

3. Learner Progress & Longitudinal Analytics

Multi-term academic progress trajectory across T1, T2, T3 with grade improvement delta, pass rate improvement delta, and trend graphs.

4. At-Risk Students Early Warning System

Automatic early detection of failing learners (<75), failing subject counts, specific failing subject alerts, and CSV exports for parent conferences.

5. DepEd Honor Roll & Awards Evaluation Modal

Automatic computation of With Honors (90-94.99), High Honors (95-97.99), Highest Honors (98-100), Subject Excellence Awards, and Special Recognition / Project Evaluation Modal.

6. Requirements Checklist & Enrollment Status

Document submission tracker (Birth Cert, Form 138, SF10, Good Moral, BEEF, ECCD, Undertaking) filtered by Complete, Pending, or Temporary enrollment.

🎮 Games & Tools — 16 Interactive Utilities

Interactive utilities designed for active classroom engagement and motivation:

1. Whiteboard

Draw ideas, diagrams, and notes on a digital canvas. Export as PNG when done.

2. Wheel of Names

Spin a colorful wheel to randomly select a name from your list. Great for recitation, group assignments, or prizes.

3. Noise Detection

Monitor classroom sound levels using the built-in microphone. Provides real-time visual feedback to manage noise.

4. Timer & Stopwatch

Track time with a stopwatch or set a countdown timer. Great for classroom activities, quizzes, and timed drills.

5. Unit Converter

Convert between length, area, mass, data, temperature, volume, time, and speed units instantly.

6. Bouncing Words

Input a sentence and watch the words bounce around jumbled. Students click them in the correct order to unscramble.

7. Group Yourself

Load learners from any class and randomly shuffle them into groups by group size or number of groups.

8. Random Groupings Generator

A dedicated, highly configurable tool to quickly divide students into random groups or pairs with export options.

9. Scoreboard

Track team points and scores during classroom games, group quizzes, and House Cup challenges.

10. Flashcards & Match

Study custom term decks with flipping cards or play a timed memory card matching game.

11. Classroom Soundboard

Play transition cues, ticking clock suspense, applause, and correct/incorrect retro sound effects.

12. Word Search Generator

Generate customizable word search puzzle boards dynamically from your spelling list.

13. Raffle Ticket Jar

Draw random student names out of a beautifully animated ticket jar.

14. Tug of War

Split your class into two teams and battle it out! Click "Pull!" to randomly tug the rope based on correct answers.

15. Coin Flip

Flip a virtual coin to decide between Heads or Tails. Tracks your flip history with a running tally.

16. Dice Roller

Roll up to 5 virtual dice with a single click. Keeps a running history of your rolls and totals.

🏆 Student ID & Certificate Generator Suite

Professional ID Canvas

Batch design and print high-resolution Student IDs with preset templates (Modern, Glassmorphism, Classic), front/back rendering, Photo Cropper tool, barcodes, QR codes, logo watermarks, and signatory sliders.

Name Tag & Badge Creator

Rapid generation of printable desk tags, field trip badges, and classroom labels.

Batch Honor Certificates

Generate academic honor certificates (With Honors, High Honors, Highest Honors), Perfect Attendance, and Conduct awards with auto-filled names and digital signatures.

🛡️ Data Security, Offline Engine & Encrypted Backups

100% Offline Engine

Runs completely without internet access. All student records remain locally stored on the user's computer inside IndexedDB.

RA 10173 Data Privacy Compliance

Zero cloud data harvesting or telemetry. Fulfills all technical and organizational data privacy requirements under the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012.

AES-256-GCM Encrypted Backups

One-click snapshot database backups (.formease / JSON) protected by AES-256-GCM cipher and PBKDF2 key derivation.

Optional Google Drive Sync

User-controlled direct Google OAuth connection to personal/school Google Drive for disaster recovery backup.

Digital Signature Integration

Upload Adviser and Principal PNG signatures dynamically embedded across ID Cards, Report Cards, SF10, Grade Slips, and Certificates.

District Adoption Proposal Documents

Official supporting documents prepared for submission to School Principals, District Supervisors, and Selection Committees for district-wide recommendation.

Complete all-in-one proposal document ready for printing or emailing to District Supervisors and Principals.
